items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Most projects: 6-12 weeks. Complex enterprise migrations: 3-6 months. We ship incrementally—you see progress fast.

items.question: Do you offer fixed-price quotes?
items.answer: Yes! After a discovery call, we provide a detailed fixed-price proposal. No hourly billing surprises.

items.question: Can you work with our existing team?
items.answer: Absolutely. We can augment your team, train your developers, or handle the entire project—whatever works best.
